research_rationale: The original creates the HIV commission with advisory, preliminary/final reporting, support, compensation and FACA provisions. Section 4(b) terminates it 30 days after actual final-report submission unless extended. Section 2(d) sets deadlines, including one year after the order; neither the deadline nor a due date establishes actual submission. EO:12603 changes only section 1(a) membership from 11 to 13 and does not extend or end the Commission. EO:12692 section 3(g) formally revokes the amended order and section 5 expressly states September 30, 1989. Its signing date is not its effect. Despite dossier missing=[] the actual final-report date is absent and the actor source is marked for a page check. Both are material. The preserved duties and reimbursement language do not eliminate the need to establish the actual earlier cessation.

Actual final-report submission date under original section 4(b), and whether any extension superseded the conditional term, are absent.

Accrued compensation/expenses and residual treatment remain unclosed until the trigger and checked revocation are established.
